name: Territories
line: An abstract atlas of the real cancer network: each exposure category is a tinted territory traced from its exposures (marching squares on a smooth field, with paper borders between neighbours), Group 1 exposures are red capitals, cancer types sit as ring-and-dot towns where the territories they link meet, and while the map stays pinned the camera flies to Occupational, Lifestyle & diet and Infections, naming every place, then pulls back for the lesson drawn as a scale bar.
notes: Territory names are spaced condensed capitals placed outside each region; place names carry a paper halo and never collide. A fine graticule travels with the map. Opening an entry flies the camera aside so the card never hides the selection. The text boxes and the search use an atlas cartouche frame (a hairline with an inner second rule). Fira Sans and Fira Sans Condensed both cover Cyrillic. Without JavaScript the explorer's network drawing stands in, muted; with reduced motion the camera cuts instead of flying.
